from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 20:25 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 Technical Delegate's Report Further investigations on the curfew issue of the Scuderia Ferrari team confirmed that the person, who was within the confines of the circuit during the eight hour period which commenced at 02:00 on 23 June, eleven hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 10:00 on 23 June, is not associated with the operation of the cars. Therefore no breach of Article 21.7 of the 2018 Formula One Sporting Regulations occurred. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
